title: ₹NaN checkout — null price from inventory API

actionItems.text: Add a regression test for lineTotal that asserts PriceUnavailableError is thrown for null price
Write a Semgrep rule flagging direct arithmetic on $X.price outside util/money.js
Fix cartTotal.js and invoice.js to use toMoney(item.price) before arithmetic
Add minimum-order-value guard at the checkout API layer (reject orders with total <= 0)
Add inventory API response validation (zod/JSON schema) at the boundary
